description_en: Calls the ModifyFlowLogAttribute operation to modify the name and description of a flow log
description_zh: 调用ModifyFlowLogAttribute接口编辑流日志的名称和描述
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-flow-log-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --flow-log-id fl-m5e8vhz2t21sel1nq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyFlowLogAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the flow log.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
流日志所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the flow log.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的流日志名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: flow_log_name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the flow log.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的流日志描述。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The new sampling interval of the flow log. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 1, 5, and 10
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的流日志的采样间隔。单位：分钟。取值：1、5、10
parameters.name: aggregation_interval

parameters.help_en: The IP version of the traffic captured by the flow log
parameters.help_zh: 流日志采集流量的IP地址类型
parameters.name: ip_version

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:

true: The operation is successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：操作成功。

false：操作失败
